info.name: Hustle Public Access Token Leads API

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: The Lead's phone number. Represented as an E.164 Format (i.e +15554441234 for (555) 444-1234 in the US).

params.name: groupId
params.description: A Group ID. This will return a lead that has this group inside of the activeGroupIds array. To also include inactive groups, use the searchInactiveGroups query parameter.

params.name: leadStatusInGroup
params.description: When a groupId is passed, this determines whether we look in the activeGroupIds array, inactiveGroupIds array, or both. Defaults to active.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for start of next set of items. Pass whatever you receive from the response to get the next elements in the array.

items.docs: Get a list of leads scoped by the query parameters.
Creates a new lead or updates the existing lead in the organization with that phone number.
Perform the specified operations on the specified leads.
